name: Cream Cheese
siboNotes: Cream cheese is naturally low in lactose due to its high fat content and processing method, making it generally well-tolerated for SIBO patients in moderate portions.
preparationTips: Allow to soften at room temperature for easier spreading
Choose plain varieties without added garlic or onion flavorings
Check ingredient labels for added inulin or chicory root fiber
Store opened packages refrigerated and use within 10 days
nutritionalHighlights: High in vitamin A for eye health
Good source of calcium for bone health
